headline: Fanta's AI-made Halloween advert, shown in cinemas, has drawn mostly negative reactions online.
score_reason: Lowered by 1: reactions date from 1 Oct 2026, before the report window; marketing story with a social media backlash.
importance_line: It shows a major brand taking an AI-made ad into cinemas despite earlier backlash to Coca-Cola's AI Christmas ads; the negative comments come from social media and may not reflect most viewers.
summary: Creative Bloq reports that Fanta, owned by the Coca-Cola Company, is running an AI-made Halloween campaign called Fanta's Haunted Universe, built by AI studio GRAiL with characters such as a cyborg Frankenstein and a werewolf DJ, and that almost all social media comments on the ad, including from cinema-goers, are negative. The company plans to continue the story yearly, and the writer notes that loud online opposition may not reflect the many people who do not care either way.
notes: Earliest dated viewer reactions in the article are 1 Oct 2026; the ad's launch date is not stated.
